title: verify_object/verify_provenance Ok(false) pit
description: fedi-integrity::verify_object (line 151) and fedi-provenance::verify_provenance (line 137) return Ok(ProofStatus{valid:false}) / Ok(false) when signature verification fails, instead of Err. This is a pit-of-failure API: any caller that checks .is_ok() without inspecting the inner bool will silently accept forged signatures. The correct design is to return Err(SignatureVerification) for invalid signatures, reserving Ok for verified-valid results. Same pattern in both crates.
close_reason: Fixed: verify_object returns Err(VerificationFailed) instead of Ok(false). verify_provenance returns Err(SignatureVerification). Tests updated.
